name: Torrox (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided blue over red, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Torrox (quartered, a castle, a lion, a tower and a scroll with the motto).
history: The official symbols of Torrox are its flag, its arms and its motto, approved by the Junta de Andalucía on 9 December 2008; the flag is a rectangular cloth of proportions 2:3, divided into two horizontal stripes, blue above and red below.

features.role: Torrox arms — quartered, castle, lion, tower and scroll with motto
